source: patchacha (mur de galerie vide, papiers washi, note 90), cirenza (mur vide de face « sans perspective », strates de cire), laure-polin (bronze, ardoise, gomme, notées 4-5), baptisteconte v6 (socles vides), aronovitch, laurent-barrera, lydia-canclaux, pixncroq (poussière dans un rayon, champ à l'heure dorée, notés 4-5), stanislas-urbi-orbi ; règle de la skill « jamais d'œuvre ni d'imitation du style de l'artiste ».
style: Quiet contemporary fine-art photograph, like a plate in a museum exhibition catalogue, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, restrained colours so that the real artworks shown nearby will stand out, subtle film grain, generous negative space, photorealistic, no CGI look.
interdits: No artwork, no painting, no drawing, no sculpture, no framed picture, no poster, no imitation of the artist's style, no people, no hands, nothing hanging on the walls.
evite: Évite la fausse œuvre et l'imitation de l'artiste : murs, socles et cadres vides où le code pose les vraies œuvres, matières et lumière.

404.consigne: An empty picture frame leaning against a bare wall on a wooden floor, soft side light, a gentle touch of humour, nothing inside the frame.
404.evite: Le cadre contenant une image inventée.

ouverture.consigne: A large empty gallery wall in {matieres}, perfectly frontal straight-on view, camera at eye level and parallel to the wall, no perspective distortion, soft even daylight, nothing on the wall.
ouverture.source: cirenza voir-au-mur, atelier-shazak mur-galerie, patchacha accueil-selection-mur-galerie (notée 4-5)
ouverture.evite: Le mur en perspective, inutilisable pour y poser une œuvre.

section-fond.consigne: Fine dust particles floating in a diagonal beam of warm sunlight against a deep shadowy background, soft bokeh, atmospheric, abstract, no objects.
section-fond.evite: Les objets reconnaissables dans le fond.

scene-metier.consigne: Close-up of {sujet} in the artist's raw material, cut cleanly to reveal its layers, raking light, abstract composition, no finished piece, no tools held by anyone.
scene-metier.source: laure-polin g-bronze-fusion (« no tools held by anyone »), cirenza strates-cire
scene-metier.evite: Le geste de l'artiste et l'œuvre en cours.

lieu.consigne: A single empty plinth in pale plaster standing in front of a warm wall, softly lit from above, a long soft shadow, nothing on top of the plinth, minimal composition.
lieu.evite: Une sculpture posée sur le socle.

texture.consigne: Extreme close-up, seen from directly above, of {matieres} laid loosely on top of each other, torn deckled edges, visible fibres, daylight passing through, calm and abstract.
texture.evite: Le dessin ou la tache qui ressemble à une œuvre.

portrait-generique.consigne: A blurred visitor silhouette passing far away in a dim exhibition room, strong backlight, motion blur, empty frames on the walls, no face, nobody else.
portrait-generique.evite: Le portrait de l'artiste, qui vient de ses vraies photos.
